description: Review and then post an ExpenseBot report to the owner's accounting destination. STEP 1: call with provider, reportId, and optional mode/mappings, without confirm. The server reads the live report and destination, applies Omit/Personal/split/date/currency rules, checks Zoho bank-feed matches, and returns the complete proposal plus proposalId. NOTHING is posted in step 1. Show the complete proposal and ask for approval. STEP 2: call with only provider, proposalId, and confirm:true. The server posts only the frozen, account-bound proposal, revalidates live state, and rejects changed reports or mappings. Never add mapping fields to the confirmation call. Owner accounts only; acting for a client is not supported. Agent-driven posting is currently available only for Zoho Books (zoho_books); QuickBooks Online, Xero, Wave, and FreeAgent are intentionally not accepted by this tool yet because their previews cannot freeze/revalidate the canonical provider plan that shareReport executes. Use those providers' web flows until they satisfy the full push contract.

accountMappings.description: Step 1 only: ExpenseBot category to live destination account ID overrides.

confirm.description: Step 2 only: true posts the exact staged proposal. No other options may change.

forceRepush.description: Step 1 only: explicitly include disclosed uncertain prior outcomes in the frozen proposal.

mode.description: Step 1 only (Zoho Books): automatic document treatment, paid expenses, or bills.

proposalId.description: Step 2 only: proposalId returned by the read-only preview.

provider.description: Accounting destination provider. Agent-driven posting is currently available only for Zoho Books.

reportId.description: Step 1 only: ExpenseBot report ID owned by the signed-in account.

optionId.description: Live option ID belonging to tagId, returned in the step-1 proposal.

tagId.description: Live accounting-provider reporting-tag ID returned in the step-1 proposal.

reportingTagMappings.description: Step 1 only: ExpenseBot tag to live destination reporting-tag option.

taxMappings.description: Step 1 only: observed tax-rate string to live destination tax ID overrides.

name: send_report_to_accounting
